assertions.assertion: The appeal is for the CO-197 denial
The denied service is CPT 93229 (Mobile Cardiac Telemetry monitoring)
The clinical indication note documents recurrent episodes of palpitations, lightheadedness, and intermittent syncope suggestive of paroxysmal atrial fibrillation and sick sinus syndrome
The submitted diagnosis codes are I49.5 and I48.0
The patient has a personal history of transient ischemic attack and cerebral infarction (Z86.73)
Continuous mobile cardiac telemetry was ordered to detect arrhythmic events and guide appropriate anticoagulation and rate-control management
The payer letter states this decision does not preclude a corrected claim or appeal
